## What

What shared behavior is wrong? Include the smallest reproduction when possible.

## How

Where does it fail, and which member repositories are affected?

## Why

What is the suite-wide impact? If only one component can fix the problem, report it in
that component instead.

## Environment

Include Python, operating system and relevant component versions.
